source.inline: function main(input) { const byRep = new Map(); for (const it of input.items) { const rep = it.data.rep || '(未設定)'; const cur = byRep.get(rep) || { visits: 0, prospect: 0 }; cur.visits += Number(it.data.visits || 0); cur.prospect += Number(it.data.prospect || 0); byRep.set(rep, cur); } const rows = [...byRep.entries()].map(([rep, v]) => ({ week_start: input.week_start, rep: rep, visits: v.visits, prospect: v.prospect })); rows.sort((a, b) => (a.rep < b.rep ? -1 : a.rep > b.rep ? 1 : 0)); const summary = rows.map(r => r.rep + ': 訪問 ' + r.visits + ' 件、見込み額 ' + r.prospect).join('\n'); return { rows: rows, summary: summary }; }
